🏁 MINI RACE - Collect CARS, build your EMPIRE, and conquer every CIRCUIT!

USE CODE "2MVISITS" FOR FREE CASH AND GEMS!

👇 HOW TO PLAY:
- Open crates to unlock rare CARS 🚗
- Build garages to grow your collection 🏠
- Train your cars to earn more money 💸

- Capture circuits to boost your earnings!
- Spawn your favorite car and hit the road!

💡 GROW YOUR EMPIRE:
- Trade with players for your dream cars!
- Expand your plot & build better garages
- Conquer tougher circuits and the GRAND PRIX!
- Your circuits generate Cash offline!

👍 Enjoy the game? Leave a thumbs up!
🐛 Found a bug? Report it in our Roblox Community!
